source: Nature 2026 main article and supplementary information

acceptance_criteria: All 47 declared work units complete from equations, published scalars, or labelled physical surrogate assumptions.
The 13 theoretical paper items each have a target-bound numerical or analytic artifact.
The runner never reads author code, author arrays, digitized curves, source pixels, raw/, or original-figure directories.
Supplement scan grids remain explicitly independent evaluation grids, never paper-exact sampling claims.
Pulse-energy, FFT, chirp, power and frequency-dependent-gamma normalization checks pass independently.
Missing fibre coefficients, pulse state, experimental arrays, and Fig. 4 fit tables continue to cap fidelity after any successful compute run.
